statement: In the one-step affine slope model gamma=C(B,2)-C(A+1,2)+2-(4-delta)q+v and B_next=C(B,2)-alpha q-beta, with fixed n, alpha, delta, beta, v and canonical B_next<q-c_n, one has gamma<(alpha+delta-3)q+(beta+v+2-c_n). Hence alpha+delta<3 forces gamma<0 on all sufficiently large actual K4,r9 odd strips. Consequently any asymptotically viable canonical local switch in this model must spend combined slope budget alpha+delta>=3; equality is necessary, not sufficient.
closes: subcritical affine leading-block and bottom-transfer switches
dependency_gaps: an exact legal Macaulay transition realizing alpha+delta>=3
